splash.notice: Character changes in this game are fantasy effects driven by game EXP and do not represent real product results. In-game items are virtual and separate from real products.
intro.1.title: You meet a tiny, lovable friend
intro.1.body: One day, an adorable guest wanders into a small, newly opened BEAUTY LIFE lounge.
intro.2.title: UNI&CORE products and DERMA HOME
intro.2.body: UNI&CORE products line the shelves, and the DERMA HOME device — RF, Ultrasonic and Iontophoresis — waits in the care zone.
intro.3.title: Growth comes from your care
intro.3.body: Complete care missions and earn EXP to see your character evolve through five stages — through your touch, not a timer.
intro.4.title: Grow a lounge of your own
intro.4.body: Welcome customers, decorate your space and share on the Beauty Feed — until your mini lounge becomes a global flagship!
create.title: Meet your character
create.desc: Give a name and pick a first look. You can change it any time.
create.name: Name
create.rotate: Drag to rotate 360° · wheel / pinch to zoom
create.diversity: No skin tone or feature ranks above another — every choice is simply your style.
hud.hint: WASD / arrows to move · click floor to walk · drag to rotate · wheel to zoom · E to interact
visit.title: Visiting {name}'s lounge
visit.demo: A sample lounge of a demo friend
edit.title: Edit interior
edit.hintMove: Tap the floor to move the selected piece there.
edit.hintSelect: Tap a piece to select it, or place one from storage below.
edit.empty: No furniture in storage. Visit the Interior Shop.
photo.title: Character Photo
photo.hint: Drag to frame the shot, pick a pose, then shoot.
photo.caption: Add a caption
care.pickDesc: Shortened missions based on the official DERMA HOME routines. In each step apply the listed product, pick an area and stroke it with the device.
care.needProduct: You have none in stock. Buy here or visit the Item Shop.
care.mistDesc: Official face routines end with a mist. Finishing earns bonus EXP.
care.fantasy: Character changes are fantasy effects driven by game EXP.
char.rotate: Drag the scene to view your character in 360°.
lounge.lpHint: Earn LOUNGE POINT by caring for customers.
shop.virtual: Purchases here are virtual in-game items, not real orders. Rarity is a collection grade, not a ranking of product quality or efficacy.
shop.mall: See real products on the official mall
shop.stored: Added to storage. Place it in Edit Interior.
codex.unverifiedDesc: Ingredients and directions have not been collected yet. Please check the official product page.
codex.disclaimer: In-game effects are unrelated to real product efficacy. For real use, follow the product manual and official guide.
social.demo: This is an in-game SNS that runs only on your device for now. Accounts and posts marked DEMO are samples, not real users.
social.phase: Real-time friends, chat, gifting and global rankings arrive with the server in Phases 4–5.
growth.note: Growth is never automatic. When EXP from care, customers, social, fashion and lounge activities reaches a stage threshold, the evolution scene begins.
cust.none: No customers right now. Someone will drop by soon!
cust.noRegulars: Guests who rate 4 or more become regulars.
cust.fiction: All customers are fictional game characters.
consult.express: Customer care runs as an express (2-step) session. ✔/✕ shows whether the lounge has the product in stock.
consult.ok: Hmm… I'll give it a try.
set.langNote: Korean and English are fully translated; other languages are a beta covering core UI. Official product names are not translated.
set.controlsBody:
PC: WASD / arrows to move · click floor to walk · drag to rotate · wheel to zoom · E / Space to interact
Mobile: left joystick or tap the floor to move · one-finger drag to rotate · two-finger pinch to zoom
set.saveFail: Browser storage is unavailable; progress lasts this session only.
set.resetAsk: All progress will be deleted. Continue?
set.title: Back to title
set.legal: UNI&CORE, DERMA HOME and product names / images belong to their owners. All 3D models are procedural assets authored for this project.
map.legend: Dashed spots are where more DERMA HOME stations can be installed.
map.locked: Preview of the layout unlocked at LEVEL {n}.
station.title: {n} DERMA HOME running (max {max} at this level)
station.desc: Extra stations let staff care for waiting customers automatically and add one more customer slot. Auto care earns less than caring yourself; soothing gel in stock raises satisfaction.
station.max: All station spots at this level are in use. Expand the lounge for more.
pet.title: Pets
pet.desc: Cats and dogs that live in your lounge. Walk up and pet them to raise affection; the higher it is, the more they follow you.
pet.none: No pets yet. Adopt one below.
pet.note: With a pet around, customers wait a little longer. The first petting each day gives SOCIAL STAR.
mini.title: Mini-game
mini.note: Match six pairs of UNI&CORE product cards. Fewer moves earn more BEAUTY COIN.
invite.reward: A friend who starts from your link gets {g} BEAUTY GEM.
invite.self: You can't add your own code
invite.note: There is no server yet, so friends are stored on this device only and codes are checked for format only. Real lounge visits and gifts arrive with online features.
rank.bonusNow: Customer pay & LOUNGE POINT +{pct}% · daily subscription bonus {coin} COIN
rank.how: Buying products adds purchase PV, using them in care adds use PV, and caring for customers adds registration points by star rating. Meet all three to rank up and receive a one-time rank-up bonus.
rank.notice: Rank names and order follow the UNI&CORE New Benefit Plan v1 guide. Numbers and bonuses are game rules and are unrelated to real ranks, commissions or income.
plaza.title: WORLD PLAZA
plaza.hint: Tap a player to send a heart and visit their lounge.
plaza.desc: An outdoor plaza where you walk and greet other players.
plaza.wish: Make a wish at the fountain
plaza.wishUsed: You already made a wish today
plaza.promoEmpty: No lounges are promoting right now.
plaza.promoHow: Pick a visit perk in the LOUNGE menu to promote your lounge here.
plaza.promoDesc: Pick a visit perk and a promo badge shows above your character in the World Plaza. When a visitor claims it you earn LOUNGE POINT and a follower. Perks are paid by the game.
plaza.noPromo: This player is not promoting a lounge.
plaza.perkOnVisit: Visit the lounge to receive this perk.
plaza.shopNote: The lounge as it was when you met in the plaza.
set.creditsBody:
Free assets (all CC0, attribution not required — credited with thanks)
· Realistic characters & animations: Quaternius — Universal Base Characters · Universal Animation Library
· 3D nature props: Quaternius — Ultimate Stylized Nature
· Sky HDRI: Poly Haven — Greg Zaal, Jarod Guest
· Grass, stone and fabric materials: ambientCG
· Sound effects: Kenney — Interface Sounds
· Music: Zane Little Music — Apple Cider · Kistol — Hot Springs Town
· Ambience: Thimras — Park Ambiences · rubberduck — 100 CC0 SFX #2
All other models are made in-house with Blender scripts.
life.title: Beauty Life
garden.desc: Plant beauty herbs in pots and water them. Harvest when grown for coins and beauty ingredients. Watering makes them grow faster.
garden.locked: Unlocks at a higher lounge level
garden.note: You can water once an hour. More pots unlock as your lounge levels up (next level: {n}). Plants keep growing while you're away.
fit.desc: Tap to the beat in rhythm workouts to raise your wellness level. New workouts unlock as you level up.
fit.note: Coin rewards up to 3 times a day; wellness points keep adding up after that. In-game workouts are for fun and don't represent real exercise or body changes.
fit.howto: Tap when the ball is in the pink zone (Space)
fit.noReward: Today's coin rewards are used up
col.desc: Open curio boxes to collect interior decor. Complete a set for a bonus. Boxes use in-game coins only. Collected curios are displayed on the wall shelves above your lounge garden; completed sets get a gold nameplate.
col.note: Duplicates are refunded as 40 coins. Odds are exactly as shown above.
lf.desc: Send friends a daily gift and water their gardens to grow together. Inviting friends unlocks milestone rewards.
lf.note: Gifts and watering give rewards up to 5 times a day. Demo friends are not real users.
sc.desc: Style a look for the theme of the day and enter. Every item has Cute, Elegant, Natural, Glam and Chic values; the theme's weights and today's trend decide the score. The whole score sheet is shown.
sc.tipNone: Stylist tip: this is already your best combination. Collect new items to score higher.
sc.note: 3 entries a day; rivals get stronger each round. 1st place gives {c} coins and followers, and every 7-day streak adds gems. Rivals are demo entrants.
look.body.sigNote: The Signature character is a finished design, so hair, outfit and makeup colours don't change.
ev.error: Couldn't load events. Please try again shortly.
ev.note: Each event gift can be claimed once during the event. Gifts are in-game currency only.
live.visit.closed: That lounge is closed now. You can only enter while the owner keeps it open.
live.openDesc: Drop by lounges their owners have opened, live. Know a friend code? Enter it to go straight in.
live.offline: Couldn't connect. You can keep playing solo.
live.emptyLobby: No lounges open yet. Open yours and be the first host.
live.closedDesc: Your lounge is closed, nobody can come in.
live.notHome: It reopens when you return to your lounge.
live.evDesc: While it runs your lounge tops the open list and visitors get a perk (once a day per lounge). Up to 3 a day.
live.evFail.limit: You've hosted all events for today
live.noticeDesc: Shows on the screens of visitors in your lounge now.
live.noticeOff: Available while your lounge is open and you're in it.
live.shopLive: The owner is online now, look around together
contest.title: Weekly lounge decorating contest
contest.desc: Enter your lounge and send hearts to the ones you love. You have {n} votes a week; a new round starts every Monday 00:00 (KST).
contest.error: Couldn't load the contest. Please try again shortly.
contest.empty: No entries yet. Be the first.
contest.note: Rewards: 1st 3000 coins + 50 gems / 2nd-3rd 2000 + 30 / 4th-10th 1000 + 10 / any entry with hearts 300 coins. Claim here once last week's results are in. Your entry shows your lounge as it was when you entered or updated.
contest.enter.auth: This friend code is already used on another device
contest.enter.error: Couldn't enter. Please try again shortly.
contest.vote.self: You can't vote for your own lounge
contest.vote.auth: This friend code is already used on another device
contest.vote.error: Couldn't send the heart. Please try again shortly.
gb.title: {name}'s lounge guestbook
gb.desc: Pick a sticker and a cheer to leave. Once per lounge a day; your first note earns {n} coins (up to {max} lounges a day).
gb.done: You already signed today. Come back tomorrow.
gb.empty: No notes yet. Be the first to sign.
gb.error: Couldn't load the guestbook. Please try again soon.
gb.mineDesc: Cheers from players who visited your lounge. Shows the latest 30.
gb.fail.self: You can't sign your own lounge
gb.fail.dup: You already signed this lounge today
gb.fail.auth: This device can't sign with this friend code
gb.fail.error: Couldn't sign the guestbook. Please try again soon
group.title: Group photo · {n}
group.started: {name} is taking a group photo. Strike a pose!
group.defaultText: {n} of us together in the lounge ✨
group.fail.alone: No one else is in the lounge to join you
group.fail.busy: A group photo is already in progress
group.fail.offline: Group photos need a live connection
care.contactOff: Place the head on the skin
care.tech.rf: RF: keep the head flat and move slowly in small circles (don't stay in one spot)
care.tech.us: Ultrasonic: short upward strokes along the grain (micro-vibration)
care.tech.ionto: Ionto: glide slowly over the area where the ampoule was applied
